headline: US futures point to a higher open as tech and AI-related names stabilize ahead of earnings and housing data
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) rise 0.58%, signaling a positive open for US large caps.
- Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) climb 1.13% as investors cautiously return to AI-related and chip shares after last week's selloff.
- Dow Jones Futures (@YM) gain 0.15% and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) advance 0.50%, indicating broader equity strength into the open.
- Fifth Third Bancorp (FITB) reports earnings before the bell, with traders watching results versus estimates for early direction in regional banks.
- The NAHB Housing Market Index is scheduled for release at 10:00 AM ET.
- Overnight, oil (@CL) prices declined while gold (@GC) ticked higher, highlighting a modest shift within commodity markets.
- Asian markets traded mixed overnight and European indices point modestly lower ahead of the US session.
- The week ahead features a heavy US earnings calendar with relatively few other major domestic catalysts on today's schedule.
